Results.ReviewText: I love my new Weber Spirit E-325 Grill.  The cooling area is more than enough for the 2 of us and company (2-4) when they come.  If heats up fast, the extra sear feature is great too.  We bought a Weber rotisserie attachment from Amazon that had a defective motor (clicking noise). Amazon gave us the Weber Customer Service No to call and after uploading a video to demonstrate the noise, they agreed it was defective and sent me a new rotisserie attachment!  Super satisfied!  You get what you pay for!!  Great product and great service!

Results.ReviewText:
Had my grill for about a month now and used enough to confident in a fair and balanced review. Staring from set up the grill wasn’t too difficult to assemble and was well packaged. Tip, unpack and lay all parts out and check next step before completely tightening bolts in case something is backwards (I wanted my wheels on the other side based on where I store it). 
The grill is sturdy and well made but there are some things I’d call out as opportunities; the back of the grill is wide open. I’d prefer having a back on the grill to keep the inside clean even when using a cover. Seems like a minor cost cutting measure. I’m also not a fan of the grate’s size and shape. This grill has two grate inserts with wider bars and wider spaces. Overall grilling surface is a bit smaller than expected.
Results.Title: Quality product with minor areas to improve

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. It lights easily, has consistant even heat and is much easier to clean than any barbeque I have ever owned! I highly reccomend it!
Results.Title: Very great BBQ! Awesome value

Results.ReviewText:
I needed to replace an old grill. I looked at other brands on sale and then just decided to look at the Weber grills. It was immediately clear that the build quality of the Weber’s was far superior to others on display. Dollar for dollar, the Weber cooking surface is a little smaller than other brands but the quality is so much better. 

Assembly was fairly easy and took about 90-minutes. The instructions were easy to follow. 

The grill operation is great. I like that each burner has its own ignitor and the sear feature takes my grilling to a whole new level. The flame hoods do a great job to prevent flare ups while cooking. 

I think my favorite feature is the removable lower tray which controls the grease. The ability to easily change the aluminum grease tray is a great feature, but being able to remove and clean the entire tray will keep my Weber grill looking and working great for years to come.
Results.Title: Worth every penny.
